QuestInfo.name: The Tranquil Garden
QuestInfo.0:
You followed the tiny bird and met a girl. She doesn't look like a new knight, so who could she be? 
Click on the girl and talk to her.
QuestInfo.1:
While talking to the girl about the Empress and the knights, some people showed up. There's someone with glasses, and someone who... Is that Hawkeye, the Chief Knight of Lightning?! 
Talk to the one who is wearing glasses.
QuestInfo.2: Politely greet Neinheart and the Chief Knight again.

0.0: Hello, are you one of the new recruits?\r\n#L0##bYes, I'm #h0#. This is my first time in Ereve. It's pretty here.#l\n#k
0.1: Ereve is a beautiful place, and peaceful. Has your training been difficult? \r\n#L0##bNothing I can't handle. I'm here to fight for Maple World, and I know that won't be easy.#l\n#k
0.2: I-I wish that it wasn't so. The suffering of so many weighs heavily on me...\r\n#L0##bUmm, I'm sorry, but who are you? You don't look like a Cygnus Knight.#l\n#k

1.0: Empress! How many times must I scold you for wandering about? Who is this?!

npc.0: Be calm, Neinheart, I don't think I'm in any danger. We may be welcoming #h0# to the Cygnus Knights very soon, so say hello.
